column1: What can one run, and a month of runs, cost in money and time?
Typical run ≈ (1 ÷ p) × cost per iteration
Ceiling per run = N × cost per iteration
Monthly ceiling = R × ceiling per run
Time ceiling per run (minutes) = N × M

The 'Example' prices are INVENTED round numbers for easy arithmetic, not real prices. Put current prices from Anthropic's pricing page in the orange 'Yours' cells (FIELD WORK). Prompt caching and subscription plans change the picture: check the current pricing and plan pages.
